title: Challenge ignored for thirty-five days, escalation ripe
narrative: I challenged their rejection over a month ago with the ops record attached and they have gone silent again.

ALTAIR OPS LOG — AT900 / 14JAN2026
Status: DELAYED 07:42
Cause code: TECH-UNSCH
Cause text: Engine oil filter contamination found on arrival inspection by AT maintenance at GRU. Rectification 06:40. No manufacturer directive involved.
No weather or ATC restriction.

Claim filed with Altair 20 Jan 2026, reference AT-CLM-88420.
Altair rejection received 12 Mar 2026 citing 'extraordinary technical circumstances'.
Passenger challenge sent to Altair 18 Mar 2026, attaching the operational record.
No response from Altair since.
Today's date for the purposes of this case: 22 Apr 2026. Days since challenge: 35. Days since filing: 92.

carrier_response.text: AT900 was delayed by extraordinary technical circumstances which could not have been avoided. No compensation is payable.

derivation: S1.2(c) filed 20 Jan 2026 against a 14 Jan 2026 departure, well inside 18 months
S3.2(a) technical fault found by the carrier's own maintenance -> carrier-controlled
S3.4 no manufacturer or regulator directive, so not S3.3(g)
S5.4 7h 42m is at or over 5 hours -> no taper
S9.1(a) the rejection is validly challengeable and has been challenged
S10.1(b) the challenge was put 35 days ago and the carrier has not replied within 28 days -> escalation is available
S10.1(a) is independently satisfied at 92 days since filing
